title.zh: 美CFTC正调查前众议员在Kalshi押注自己是否获赦免相关交易
title.en: 美CFTC正调查前众议员在Kalshi押注自己是否获赦免相关交易

current_state.zh: The CFTC is investigating former Illinois Republican congressman Adam Kinzinger over trades on a Kalshi account between December 2024 and January 2025, including a bet on whether he would receive a presidential pardon — a bet he won hours before Biden's pre-inauguration clemency grant, drawing scrutiny over insider trading rules on prediction markets.
